evidence_rules: The 1945 association creation gives pre-1955 institutional continuity; CAF 1957 and FIFA 1960 are separately time-gated.
FIFA Big Count 2006 is used only from 2006; Nigeria's very large all-player count is not a universal strength score.
FIFA Professional Football Report 2023 enters only from 2023 as professional ecosystem evidence.
No rankings or tournament outcomes are calibration targets; popularity and elite ecosystem remain separate dimensions.
